items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; analytics quality is yellow due to source issues. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior, and continue the existing read-only evidence matrix without duplicate work or production changes.

Retain the candidate plan's containment-only execution and deferred backlog. No new queue work, deployment, dependency, telemetry, credential or permission change, external outreach, or requeue is security-supported this cycle. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and bounded read-only security evidence work using authorized metadata and retained artifacts; do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, or claim certification or a clean bill of health.
